paper.title_en: A Charged Compact Star Solution for a Conducting Sphere
paper.abstract_en: This paper considers the simplest charged stellar model, namely, a uniform density star with electric charge distributed on its surface. In this model, we treat the uniform density star as a conducting sphere, where all electric charges are uniformly distributed on the surface and represented by a delta function. We obtain an analytical solution for the background metric of the star spacetime and find that the pressure of the perfect fluid inside the star is directed inward (negative pressure) near the inner surface. This is because the repulsive force between surface electric charges requires an inward pressure to maintain equilibrium. However, when the charge becomes too large, the pressure of the ideal fluid at the stellar center gets directed outwards again. This is because the electric field itself is also a part of the stress energy tensor $T_{μν}$, acting as a source of gravity. When the gravitational effect of the electric field dominates, the perfect fluid must provide outward pressure to balance the inward gravitational attraction. On the other hand, we have also studied the axial perturbation in charged spacetimes using the finite difference method. We found that axial Maxwell perturbation and axial gravitational perturbation are coupled in the star spacetime, making it difficult to separate the variables by coordinate transformation. The computational results show that the waveforms of quasinormal modes vary with different charges.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文给出带电匀速密度星体（导体球）背景度规的解析解，分析表面电荷斥力对压强分布的影响，并用有限差分法研究轴向 Maxwell-引力扰动耦合及准正规模随电荷的变化，属于广义相对论基础中致密星与扰动理论的有意义工作，适合进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 一个带电致密星的导体球解
decision.abstract_zh: 本文考虑最简单的带电恒星模型，即电荷分布在其表面上的匀速密度星。在该模型中，我们将匀速密度星视为一个导体球，其中所有电荷均匀分布在表面上，并用 delta 函数表示。我们得到了该恒星时空背景度规的解析解，并发现恒星内部理想流体的压强在内表面附近指向内部（负压强）。这是因为表面电荷之间的排斥力需要一个向内的压强来维持平衡。然而，当电荷变得太大时，恒星中心处理想流体的压强又再次指向外部。这是因为电场本身也是应力能量张量 $T_{\mu\nu}$ 的一部分，作为引力的源起作用。当电场的引力效应占主导时，理想流体必须提供向外的压强以平衡向内的引力吸引。另一方面，我们还用有限差分法研究了带电时空中的轴向扰动。我们发现，轴向 Maxwell 扰动与轴向引力扰动在恒星时空中是耦合的，使得通过坐标变换分离变量变得困难。计算结果表明，准正规模的波形随不同电荷而变化。
